messages:
alex-pm: Heads-up: CloudBridge marketplace goes live Thu 09:00 PT. Need partner SEV path and shared-channel war room template this week.

kai-se: Yep. Last launch had fuzzy handoff. My quick proposal:
- Create shared channel #cbx-warroom and invite partner liaison + our oncall
- 10m in-channel triage then escalate to audio bridge if unresolved
- PD paging sequence: Redwood eng-oncall -> SRE lead, 5m intervals

rachel-oncall: I'll cover morning rotation. Please confirm PD paging list + phone numbers so I can test.

cloudbridge-liaison: Our incident lead Mateo (mateo@cloudbridge.io) + infra SME Anita will join. Legal on standby for data concerns.

jamie-eng: Let's pin a short ops snippet partners can paste: 
```
P1: @rachel-oncall @jamie-eng
/runbook partner-escalation
/bridge cbx-audio
pin: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-cbx
```

ops-bot: Channel #cbx-warroom created; invites sent to alex-pm, kai-se, rachel-oncall, cloudbridge-liaison, jamie-eng :white_check_mark:

kai-se: Runbook edge cases to add:
1) If PII/payment data mentioned -> tag @security and do NOT paste logs in-channel.
2) If model-quality issue -> tag @applied-ml with failing prompts before infra escalations.

rachel-oncall: Triage rule: if triage >10m and severity P1 -> start audio bridge + PD escalation. I'll maintain PD schedule; ping me for rotation updates.

cloudbridge-liaison: We'll upload our incident form (customer-impact, repro-steps, sample request) to align templates. Also share SOC contact.

jamie-eng: Ops detail: enable automatic fallback routing for marketplace inference traffic; if primary cluster fails, route to fallback endpoint and page infra. I'll document in infra-runbook.

kai-se: I'll draft a one-slide checklist for kickoff: who to ping, bridge link, pinned template, do/don't share.

alex-pm: Action items:
- alex-pm: finalize pinned runbook blurb and add to launch invite (EOD)
- rachel-oncall: confirm PD paging list + phone numbers and test alerts (EOD)
- jamie-eng: publish fallback routing note in infra-runbook and link it (tomorrow)
- cloudbridge-liaison: upload partner incident form and SOC contact (ASAP)

cloudbridge-liaison: We'll provide a primary phone contact for Mateo for the launch window.

rachel-oncall: Once PD list is updated I'll send a test page to verify routing. Callouts welcome for test participants.

alex-pm: Thanks everyone. I'll post the finalized summary to the shared channel and lock the runbook into the calendar invite.
